renderProfile.kind: 4K industrial material lookdev stills for fixed ball valve

ready.sourceBoundary: Original STEP and brochure are not modified; this lookdev uses the derived fixed-ball-valve.glb.
ready.renderBoundary: Goal 15 renders 4K material lookdev stills only; no 240-frame release sequence, homepage replacement, or fluid claim.
ready.materialThesis: commercial graphite pressure body, polished stainless ball core, dark fixed seat/seal system, satin machined drive/support, brighter steel fasteners

ballIsolation.invariant: Only the true ball core receives ballTurn; valve seats and seat seals remain fixed material groups.

ready.truthBoundary: No pressure, flow rate, zero-leakage, fire-safe, anti-static, DBB/DIB, material grade, or medium claim is made.
